verdict.rationale: Mollie documents ways to get some of your own data out: Settlement Reports give a full breakdown of transactions, fees and deductions per payout, and the Balances and Chargebacks APIs return current and historical account data, explicitly framed as useful for bookkeeping and reconciliation. There is no documented whole-account export, open-format guarantee or offboarding path, so this covers only fragments of the story. Missing for 10: a documented bulk export of all account data, stated open file formats (e.g. CSV/JSON) for reports, data portability for customers, mandates and stored payment methods, an account-closure/offboarding process, and independent corroboration.
